guide.body:
Murmur controls are running. Service and connection status are checked separately.

To return, open the Murmur shortcut on your Desktop or in Start. If you do not have a shortcut, open Open-Murmur.cmd from this bundle.

Windows may move the icon under the hidden-icons arrow (^) even after showing it at first. That does not mean Murmur has stopped. Open the arrow and drag Murmur into the visible area if you want to keep the icon in view.

quit.confirm:
This removes the Murmur icon. The service keeps running.

To open the controls again, open Open-Murmur.cmd from this bundle. After a successful launch, you can also use the Murmur shortcut on your desktop or in Start.

Quit the tray?
